name: What is the professional process for repairing water-damaged bathroom drywall?

mainEntity.name: What is the professional process for repairing water-damaged bathroom drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contractors assess the extent of moisture, cut out damaged areas cleanly to the nearest studs, treat framing if damp, and install moisture-rated boards. After fastening new drywall, technicians apply fiberglass mesh tape and moisture-tolerant setting-type joint compound across seams. Once the mud dries and is sanded smooth, the area receives a dedicated mold-inhibiting primer before topcoat bathroom paint is rolled on. Using exhaust fans during work helps speed drying in enclosed spaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Technicians remove damp material back to sound studs, install moisture-resistant board, apply mesh tape with setting compound, sand smooth, and seal with a moisture-resistant primer.
